scoring_justification: The checker recomputes μ_eff from the Hamiltonian and Boltzmann weighting using exactly the same procedure the paper describes, so it does not need a stored gold table; it compares the agent's CSV entries to the recomputed reference values point by point.

outputs.description: Computed effective magnetic moments for all combinations of k, v, and kT/λ as listed in the parameter grid. The hidden checker compares each mu_eff to reference values with a tolerance; the tolerance is not disclosed in this public contract.

output_contract.notes: The scoring compares the agent’s mu_eff values to the paper‑reported reference values. The computed moments are deterministic, so an exact‑match policy with an appropriate tolerance is used. No internal implementation details or tolerances are exposed.
